evidence.title: BYOK: Use Your Own AI Models in ABP Studio AI Agent | ABP.IO

name: BYOK: Use Your Own AI Models in ABP Studio AI Agent
summary: Article on connecting your own LLM provider — OpenAI-compatible, Azure OpenAI or Ollama — to the ABP Studio AI agent.
description: A September 2026 ABP Community article by Alper Ebiçoğlu explaining Bring Your Own Key support in the ABP Studio AI agent: choosing between the built-in model catalog and provider connections (OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Azure OpenAI, company gateways, vLLM, LM Studio, local Ollama), which license tiers can use BYOK, and which models ship as defaults.
contains: how to switch the AI connection between built-in AI and provider connections
supported providers: OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Azure OpenAI, gateways, vLLM, LM Studio, Ollama
built-in catalog of 600 LLMs billed through ABP AI Credits
shipped default models include Claude Sonnet 5 and Claude Haiku 4.5
